title: nft-folder-macos
tagline: create a .eth folder on macos and watch it getting filled with nfts

prizes.placement: 🥇 1inch — Best Use of Dev Portal APIs
prizes.title: 1inch Network
Enhance your app with 1inch Developer Portal APIs

description:
- macos app with a finder extension
- name a folder with an ethereum address
- folder's icon is automatically updated with a ens avatar or blockies
- all mainnet nfts for provided address are synced into that folder
- right click any synced file to view it on opensea
- create as many .eth folders as you wish
how_its_made:
- macos app with a finder extension
- watching if there are changes in the working directory
- using https://github.com/holic/ens-ideas to resolve ens
- when there is an ethereum address — getting all nft metadata from 1inch api
- downloading all nft files
- remembering file ids relationships to specific nfts
- when some file is right-click, opening an opensea link for a corresponding nft
